entities.summary: David Vernon "D. J." Reader Jr. is an American professional football nose tackle. He played college football for the Clemson Tigers and was drafted by the Houston Texans in the fifth round of the 2016 NFL draft. Reader has also played for the Cincinnati Bengals and Detroit Lions.
